load_scenario_from_json: load a scenario from JSON data using JsonScenarioImporter and return the benchmark scenario with completed events
find_scenario_paths_in_dataset: find scenario file paths in a dataset directory or JSONL file using fsspec filesystem abstraction
setup_scenarios_iterator_local: set up a local scenarios iterator from a dataset path with optional config and split parameters
setup_scenarios_iterator_huggingface: set up a HuggingFace scenarios iterator by dataset name, config, and optional revision
extract_jsonl_scenario_paths: extract scenario paths from a JSONL file by parsing trace_id fields from each line
